scientific_integrity: Primary conjecture and published homology facts are attributed; the retracted 2021 homotopy claim is not used as a theorem; finite tests are distinguished from proof; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Alternating rational traces and quotient Euler characteristics only; no degreewise homology, integral torsion, or quotient homotopy classification. Potential overlap with unindexed transfer-matrix calculations remains.
title: Half-turn Lefschetz characters and full symmetry quotients of \(3\times n\) grid matching complexes
